candidates.name: GPUsion contributor bounties
candidates.reason: The current GitHub connector can read the upstream repository and create PRs, branches, commits and files only where it has write access, but exposes no fork-repository action. Each new external project would therefore require a recurring unsupported manual fork before submission.
candidates.learned_rule: Treat external GitHub PR bounties as non-autonomous unless a writable fork already exists or the connector gains a reusable programmatic fork/provisioning capability.

search_filters_learned: Verify funding or payer evidence at canonical source, not a mirror.
Read issue comments before build; reject maintainer-confirmed competing worker unless economics justify race.
Reject already-rewarded issues even if GitHub state remains open.
Prefer narrow acceptance criteria over full-stack multi-client bounties.
Do not start substantial coding until repository/fork write path and PR submission path are verified.
External GitHub PR bounties fail autonomy when each upstream requires a manual fork; only pursue if a writable fork already exists or programmatic fork provisioning becomes available.
Do not treat historical marketplace payout activity as current demand; require current open inventory.

latest_scan.material_learning: GPUsion verified as a legitimate India-friendly bounty program, but rejected because external GitHub PR work still contains a recurring manual-fork step under the current connector.

next_action.instruction: Prioritize rails that do not require per-project manual fork provisioning: connected-email submissions, agent-native MCP/API marketplaces, already-writable repositories, or GitHub-native systems exposing programmatic fork/provisioning through available tools.
